director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch ki tarah dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Pitch ka ek stump 0 aur doosra 1 socho; batsman beech mein ruka.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai. Beech ka mark 2 barabar gaps banata hai; iska naam 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Zaroor. Riya, 0 se 1 tak ki rekha ko ek poora hissa samjho. Bhinn usi poore hisse ka chhota barabar hissa dikhata hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

near 3 sahi nahi hai. Screen par ghar se chai ki dukaan tak ki sadak hai, 0 se 1 km, aur ek khilona beech wale mark par ruka hai. Woh sadak ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka number 1/2 km hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Yahan tak theek hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab isi line par tha, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi line par hai. Screen par upar wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, par ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Neeche ek doosri line hai, jis par beech mein 7 marks hain. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai. Har do paas-paas marks ke beech ka hissa gino. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 metre tak ka ribbon hai, beech mein 3 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Bhinn hisse ka naam hai, nishaan ka nahi, isliye pehla nishaan 1/4 metre par hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi, aap batao

Saat nishaan usse barabar chhote hisson mein baantte hain; nishaan aur hisson ki sankhya dhyan se gino. 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?
director.card: 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

director.text: ruko, main khud karti hoon
Theek hai Riya, pehle nishaan tak kitna hissa hai, khud gin kar batao.
sawaal kya hai?
1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

director.text: one eighth of a metre
Haan, sahi hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 8 tha, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8. Taiyaar ho aage ke liye?
mujhe cricket pasand hai
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Riya, ab tumne dikhaya ki barabar gaps ginne se pehla bhinn-mark pehchana ja sakta hai. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
8 barabar gaps mein har gap chhota gap hota hai; pehla mark 1/8 hota hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe nahi pata

Har gap ki lambai socho. Jitne zyada barabar gaps, utna har gap chhota; 0 ke paas wala pehla mark bhi chhota door hoga. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai. Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Pehle yeh hissa. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Accha, batane ke liye thanks! Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

director.text: 1/3 km

1/3 nahi: 4 barabar gaps poore 1 km mein hain. Pehla khamba sirf pehle gap par hai. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 km door hai, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Chalo, aage badhein?
haan, samajh aaya

Ab sankhya rekha par gaps aur marks ka rishta yaad rakhkar naya sawaal dekho. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
